name: Irini Sengir
description: The dwarven king's daughter kidnapped and turned into a vampire by Sengir.

description_citations.text: "Sengir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Irini Sengir mocks a renegade rallying the rabble as no true Crusader.
timeline.quote: "A renegade rallying the rabble does not a true Crusader make."

citation.text: Aysen Crusader (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Irini Sengir vows to take the Wizards' School from Reveka.
timeline.quote: Their sorcerers' school shall yet be ours."

citation.text: Mystic Decree (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Reveka calls Irini Sengir Sengir's daughter in spirit.
timeline.quote: She is Sengir's daughter in spirit if not in blood."

citation.text: Irini Sengir (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sengir slaughters the dwarves of the Castle of Morning Light and kidnaps the king's daughter, renaming her Irini Sengir.
timeline.quote: He turned her into a vampire, charming her to love him like a father and renaming her Irini Sengir .

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: He turned her into a vampire, charming her to love him like a father

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A cruel Dwarf who is Sengir's daughter in spirit if not in blood.

citation.text: Homelands: card flavor text (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A Sengir who mocks a renegade and loves funerals.
